notes: Log Rotation + Backup Retention QoL: Agent City now bounds local log growth and makes backup pruning explicitly user-controlled. Launcher and update-runner logs rotate at 10 MiB with three retained generations; the Agent City server log is continuously captured through the desktop supervisor with the same rotation policy; Agent City-owned Ollama logs rotate when Agent City starts Ollama without taking control of an already-running shared Ollama service. Admin Backup History now reports true total backup count/size and includes an opt-in retention selector: Keep all (default), latest 10, 20, 50, or 100. No backup is automatically deleted until a retention limit is explicitly chosen. No Simulation authority, citizen behavior, world truth, or autonomy changes.
